paragraphs.text: The officer and soldiers took Dante's to Judge Villefort.
What is your name and what do you do?
I am an officer on the pharaoh, one of Mr. Morrell's ships.
Where were you when the soldiers came?
The past few days had been so happy.
And he was about to become captain of the pharaoh.
But now he didn't know what was happening.
I have a letter here that says you work for Napoleon.
It says you are a dangerous man.
Do you want to kill the king and bring back Napoleon?
You didn't see him on the island of Elba recently?
It was the last order of my captain, Captain Leclerc.
Before he died, he asked me to go to Elba and meet Napoleon.
You say you don't care about politics?
That you were only following the orders of your dying captain?
If this is true, then perhaps it is not so serious.
No sir, I don't care about politics or Napoleon.
I was only trying to do my duty.
Where is the letter for Paris?
Your men took it when they arrested me.
If the letter isn't dangerous, you can go back to your wedding.
The soldiers gave the letter to Villefort.
If the letter got to Paris, there would be a lot of problems for the king and for Villefort.
Dante said he didn't read the letter.
Villefort remembered, but maybe he was lying.
The safest thing for the king and for Villefort would be to put Dante's in prison.
Dante's watch Villefort read the letter.
He didn't know what was in the letter, but he was worried.
The look on Villefort's face was not good.
Suddenly Villefort threw the letter into the room's fire.
If anyone asks about the letter, tell them to talk to me.
Now, I will keep you here at the court until tonight.
But you must never tell anyone about this letter.
He thought he would soon see Mercedes and his father.
He will take care of you.
Dante's followed the soldier out of the room and into another part of the court.
Dante's was taken to a small cell.
The soldier locked him inside and left.
He was alone in the dark, but he still trusted Villefort.
I just need to wait and then I will be free.
Tonight I will go home to Mercedes and my father.
A few hours later the soldiers returned.
When the soldiers came, Dante's felt much better.
But instead the soldiers took him to a small ship.
Judge Villefort said I could go home.
The prison on that island is your new home.
Judge Villefort ordered us to take you there.
Dante's knew the island where the soldiers were taking him.
It was a very famous prison.
It was only for the worst criminals and enemies of the king.
When Dante's arrived at the island, one of the prison soldiers came out to meet him.
He took him to a small cell.
Will I ever leave this island?
Will I ever see my father again?
The next morning the guard brought him some food.
I want to see the head of the prison.
If he wants to see you, he will call for you.
If you want to see him, no one cares.
The guard would come, give Dante some bread and water, and ask if he was okay.
After a while Dante stopped asking to meet anyone.
How would he ever get out of this prison and off the island?
